allow.1.3: Question 3 is the test's select-all about a scale factor alone: five statements about k, k² and the angles, with no other number in it, so a version is a value of k. Ruling 43 takes off the scale factors the lessons and the reference sheet work these facts with (1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 4, 5 and 0.4), and the forms take 3 and 4: 11 values of k — 6 to 10, 3.5, 4.5, and 0.5, 0.8, 1.2, 1.6. Every other part of the page has more than 100 versions.
